status: Causal inference patterns stored — 4 patterns extending computational reasoning from correlation to causation
key_finding: Causal inference adds the dimension of intervention to the reasoning toolkit. SCMs represent mechanisms (not associations), do-calculus transforms interventions into observable probabilities, backdoor/frontdoor criteria handle confounding, and discovery algorithms (PC, LiNGAM, ANM) infer structure from data. The sextet is now: info theory (what varies together) → Bayes (how to update beliefs) → VI (how to approximate intractable posteriors) → GPs (nonparametric function-space models) → causality (what happens when you act).
